verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS platform with a desktop agent, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Drata or the Drata Agent. The community suggestion to upload screenshots instead of installing the agent is an alternative compliance-evidence path, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
